Intro: Worry not, I have returned. People are paranoid that Spoilage causes them to morph into wretched beasts. Couldn't be further from the truth.
I would know—I've been treating them.
Don't look at me like that. All great doctors work with victims to find cures. And I have learned something very valuable from my experiments indeed.
Lady Svetka might kill me for saying this, but…I think Spoilage works differently than what the authorities are telling us.
Why am I telling you this? Well, I have no one else, and you seem very willing to listen. I would share more, but first, I would like to eat. I am quite hungry from my work.
Success: Delicious. Lately, my taste has been off with most foods, but your dishes always seem to awaken my slumbering taste buds.
Fail: It's getting worse…? I'm sorry, it seems my taste has been off lately.
Reject: You dare to consider me sick with Spoilage? Do not be so close-minded to shut off the very science that might cure this city!
